entities.name: Justina
entities.description: A woman who cast a great spell to imbue her weapons with her life force as evil ones came to slay her.

entities.name: Mi'cha
entities.description: A man who threw a drunken soldier over ten meters.

entities.name: Gnerdel
entities.description: An Ogre philosopher who believed life's purpose was to live as high on the food chain as possible.

entities.name: Dominia
entities.description: The world Demons were created to destroy and Grizzlies roam.

entities.name: Hela
entities.description: A figure who will call the bones of sinners forth for the final battle at Ragnarok.

entities.name: Ragnarok
entities.description: The final battle for which the bones of sinners wait in the Great Wall in Hel.

entities.name: Zombie Master
entities.description: A controller of zombies, said to have commanded them before his own death and now one of them.

entities.name: Scryb Sprites
entities.description: Faerie-like sprites who routed intruders.

entities.name: Hurloon Minotaurs
entities.description: Minotaurs of the Hurloon Mountains who love battle and sing hymns for the dead.

entities.name: Hurloon Mountains
entities.description: The mountain home of the Minotaurs.

entities.name: Ali Baba
entities.description: A figure who pronounced the words 'Open, Sesame!' at the cavern entrance.

entities.name: Sarsour
entities.description: A man against whom the landscape itself turned in a sandstorm.

entities.name: Aladdin
entities.description: A youth on whose finger a magician placed a ring.

entities.name: Aladdin's Ring
entities.description: A ring the magician called a talisman against all evil so long as Aladdin obeys him.

entities.name: Jandor
entities.description: A traveler whose saddlebags were full of food each day.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: An artificer, brother of Mishra, and Tocasia's apprentice; leader in the war against Mishra.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother and rival in the brothers' war, a creator of war machines.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Urza's greatest assistant, promoted to master after creating clay warriors.

entities.name: Kroog
entities.description: A city allied with Urza that was destroyed by Mishra's forces.

entities.name: Battle of Sarinth
entities.description: A battle where a handful of peasant-pikemen held off three Craw Wurms.

entities.name: Maeveen O'Donagh
entities.description: Soldier and author of Memoirs of a Soldier.

entities.name: Knights of Thorn
entities.description: Knights who broke the Goblin host in the Goblin Wars.

entities.name: Lacjsi
entities.description: A speaker whose speech made the Knights determined to crush their enemies clan by clan.

entities.name: Raganorn
entities.description: A man who unsealed the catacombs and found more than the dead.

entities.name: Hurkyl
entities.description: Drafna's wife, who was the true author of a spell attributed to Drafna.

entities.name: Drafna
entities.description: Founder of the College of Lat-Nam, husband of Hurkyl.

entities.name: Tocasia
entities.description: The brothers' original master, who led them in exploring Koilos.

events.summary: Justina casts a great spell, imbuing her weapons with her life force, as evil ones approach to slay her.
events.quote: she cast a great spell, imbuing her weapons with her own life force

events.summary: Mi'cha throws a drunken soldier over ten meters before the blow lands.
events.quote: His blow never landed; Mi'cha flung the brute over ten meters.

events.summary: The Scryb rout intruders, who flee.
events.quote: Then those intruders who were still standing turned and fled.

events.summary: Gnerdel refuses to eat vegetarians, living on creatures that prey on sentient beings.
events.quote: She refused to eat vegetarians

events.summary: The Zombie Master, said to have controlled zombies in life, becomes one of them in death.
events.quote: now that he is one of them, nothing can make them betray him

events.summary: A sandstorm rises against Sarsour and rearranges the landscape so he is lost.
events.quote: Even the landscape turned against Sarsour, first rising up and pelting him, then rearranging itself so he could no longer find his way.

events.summary: Ali Baba reaches the cavern entrance and speaks the words 'Open, Sesame!'
events.quote: When he reached the entrance of the cavern, he pronounced the words, 'Open, Sesame!'

events.summary: The magician puts a talisman ring on Aladdin's finger.
events.quote: the magician drew a ring off his finger, and put it on one of Aladdin's

events.summary: Jandor finds his saddlebags full of food each day of the journey.
events.quote: Each day of their journey, Jandor opened the saddlebags and found them full of mutton, quinces, cheese, date rolls, wine, and all manner of delicious and satisfying foods.

events.summary: Urza gives amulets to the healers of Kroog as a sign of friendship, drawing thousands to the city.
events.quote: Urza gave the healers of the city potent amulets

events.summary: Kroog is destroyed while most of its defenders are at Urza's side, and Urza vows that his allies will never need to fear for their defense again.
events.quote: After Kroog was destroyed while most of its defenders were at his side, Urza vowed that none of his allies would ever need to fear for their own defense again

events.summary: Tawnos creates clay warriors; Urza promotes him from apprentice to master.
events.quote: Urza ended his apprenticeship, promoting him directly to the rank of master.

events.summary: The war between Urza and Mishra makes Dominia itself a casualty of war.
events.quote: the war between Urza and Mishra made Dominia itself a casualty of war

events.summary: A handful of peasant-pikemen hold off three Craw Wurms at the Battle of Sarinth.
events.quote: a handful of peasant-pikemen held off a trio of rampaging Craw Wurms

events.summary: Mishra is eventually defeated.
events.quote: By the time Mishra was defeated

events.summary: Raganorn unseals the catacombs and finds more than the dead and their treasures.
events.quote: When Raganorn unsealed the catacombs, he found more than the dead and their treasures.

events.summary: After Lacjsi's speech the Knights grow determined to crush their ancient enemies clan by clan.
events.quote: After Lacjsi's speech, the Knights grew determined to crush their ancient enemies clan by clan.

events.summary: Maeveen O'Donagh's troop hides pikes in the grass to face a cavalry charge.
events.quote: we faced them with swords drawn and pikes hidden in the grass at our feet

events.summary: Maeveen O'Donagh is made to stand helpless as his whole troop is killed.
events.quote: standing there helpless as they killed my whole troop

events.summary: Hurkyl's Recall, attributed to Drafna, was actually the work of his wife and former student Hurkyl.
events.quote: was actually the work of his wife and former student, Hurkyl.

events.summary: Urza gives potent amulets to the healers of Kroog as a sign of friendship, drawing thousands to the city.
events.quote: Urza gave the healers of the city potent amulets

events.summary: Tocasia is revealed as the likely inventor of the Grapeshot Catapult creatures used by both brothers.
events.quote: invented by Urza's and Mishra's original master, Tocasia, and that both brothers used them

events.summary: A man recalls Maeveen's helplessness as his whole troop is killed.
events.quote: standing there helpless as they killed my whole troop

relations.quote: The Minotaurs of the Hurloon Mountains are known for their love of battle.

relations.note: Hela will call the bones forth at Ragnarok.
relations.quote: Hela will call them forth for the final battle.

relations.note: The ring is a talisman so long as Aladdin obeys the magician.
relations.quote: It is a talisman against all evil, so long as you obey me.

the city of Kroog would never fall to Mishra's forces

relations.note: The people of Kroog were among his first allies.
relations.quote: Among the first allies Urza gained were the people of Kroog.
